Subject: Quick follow-up + EMR options that won’t slow you down

Hi Ebony & Marketa,

I’ve been thinking about your setup since our call, especially what you said about leads coming in but not converting fast enough and the frustration of having to piece together multiple systems. That’s exactly where things start to feel messy and expensive, even when the business itself is strong.

I also want to say this gently… I didn’t love that we ended without a next step booked. Not because I want to push you, but because this is usually the moment where things either move forward or quietly stall, and I don’t want that for you both when you’re this close to tightening everything up and stepping into the new location with confidence.

On the EMR side, here are the 2–3 best options I’d actually recommend for you based on what you shared:

**1. Jane App**  
Best overall balance of ease + functionality  
- Starting around $79/month  
- Clean interface, easy for staff to actually use  
- Solid charting, scheduling, and client experience  
- Integrates well with GHL workflows (we’ve done this before)  
→ If you want something that just works without headaches, this is usually the safest bet

**2. CharmHealth**  
Best for more medical-heavy requirements  
- Starting around $25/month  
- Stronger clinical documentation + compliance  
- API-friendly, so we can connect it deeper into your workflows  
→ Great if your physician is more particular about medical structure

**3. Practice Better**  
Best for client experience + flexibility  
- Starting around $35/month  
- Good mix of EMR + client engagement tools  
- Works well with GHL via sync tools  
→ Ideal if you want something modern and client-friendly without overcomplicating things

If I’m being honest, most of the friction you’re feeling right now isn’t just the EMR itself. It’s that the system around it isn’t fully connected yet. That’s why even “good” platforms can still feel broken.

And that’s also why I don’t want you making this decision in a vacuum.

Let’s do this the right way:

I’d like to get back on for 20–30 minutes and map:
- exactly what your physician needs vs what your front desk needs  
- what can be automated vs what should stay manual  
- and which system actually supports your growth (not just today, but when that new location opens)

No pressure to move forward with us on the program yet. This is just to make sure you don’t choose something that slows you down again.

Here’s a link to grab a time that works for you both:
[Insert Calendar Link]

I’d recommend we do this sooner rather than later, especially with the new location coming up. The earlier we lock in the right foundation, the easier everything else becomes.

You’ve already built something strong. This is just about tightening the pieces so it actually feels that way day to day.

Talk soon,  
Bethany

Subject: Quick follow-up + EMR options for you both

Hi Ebony & Marketa,

It was really great talking with you both. I’ve been thinking more about your setup, especially what you shared around leads coming in but not converting quickly and how frustrating it’s been having to piece together multiple systems just to make things work.

I know a big part of your decision right now is finding the right EMR, so I wanted to send over a few solid options that we’ve seen work really well alongside GHL:

**Jane App**  
Best overall balance of ease + functionality  
- Starts around $79/month  
- Very user-friendly for staff  
- Strong scheduling, charting, and client experience  
- Integrates smoothly with GHL workflows  
→ Great if you want something clean, reliable, and easy to adopt

**CharmHealth**  
Best for more medical-focused needs  
- Starts around $25/month  
- Stronger on clinical documentation and compliance  
- API-friendly for deeper integrations  
→ Good fit if your physician wants something more medically robust

**Practice Better**  
Best for client experience + flexibility  
- Starts around $35/month  
- Nice blend of EMR + client engagement tools  
- Syncs well with GHL  
→ Solid middle-ground option that feels modern and flexible

From what you both described, the biggest issue isn’t just picking an EMR, it’s making sure everything actually works together so you’re not losing people in that gap between lead → response → booking. That’s where most of the revenue leakage is happening, and it’s fixable pretty quickly once the right system is in place.

If it’s helpful, I’d love to hop back on for a quick 20–30 minute call to:
- help you choose the best-fit EMR for your exact setup  
- map how it connects with GHL so everything flows smoothly  
- and make sure you’re set up properly going into the new location  

No pressure at all, just want to make sure you’re making the right move here and not ending up with another system that creates more work.

Here’s a link if you want to grab a time:
[Insert Calendar Link]

Excited for what you’re building, especially with the new location coming up. There’s a lot of opportunity here once the backend is tightened up.

Talk soon,  
Bethany
